identity_result.caret_rule: The caret marker is identity-only. Communications receive event IDs and canonical anchors, never presentation carets. Pending exact organs are not printed with a caret.

public_excludes: mail provider message or thread identifiers
privacy_boundary.native_sources: Remain in authorised private custody; this checkpoint is a public-safe aggregate and canonicalisation record.

proof_boundary: Search hits and document matches are discovery leads. A sent item proves only the located transport state; a REGAGE receipt proves formal presentation to the stated registry; an official routing notice proves only the routing stated in that notice. None alone proves downstream delivery, incorporation, examination, adoption, reliance, personal knowledge, intent, causation, criminal organisation, offence or guilt.
open_controls: Item-level relevance and duplicate reconciliation remain open for discovery hits not represented by the 19 controlled events.
Exact CAEPR identity remains open for every organ listed as pending.
Yaiza filings without individually controlled primary receipts remain unallocated.
For every event, routing, incorporation, examination, verification, adoption, decision, effect and reliance require separate source proof.
Legacy public-source privacy debt must be remediated prospectively without rewriting Git history or destroying private originals.
